name: claude-accounts
description: Multi-account Claude Code for WSL/Linux (per-window isolation + shared history) with live usage: 5h, 7d, Fable/Opus/Sonnet — workspace extension, never binds to a Windows Claude binary.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Claude accounts live in data directories on the local file system, which virtual workspaces don't have.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Works in Restricted Mode. The extension never reads or executes workspace content — it only uses the workspace folder path to tell windows apart.

claudeAccounts.failover.mode.description: CLI/policy side: off = meter only. notify = meter only (usage pressure is shown by the status-bar meter, no popup). cli = PATH orchestrator for new claude processes. Panel cutover is separate (failover.panelCutover).

claudeAccounts.failover.panelCutover.description: Panel failover timing: never mid-turn. off = no panel action. notify = meter only (no popup; the status-bar meter shows pressure and you switch when you choose). idleReload = after the turn settles, auto switchTo (bind + window reload) to the next account by strategy. Workspace path pins are never auto-left.

claudeAccounts.failover.strategy.description: How to choose among N accounts when no workspace route applies. lowestUsage = coolest by max(enabled dimension %%). ordered = walk accountOrder and take the first cool account.

claudeAccounts.failover.accountOrder.description: Account ids (emails or registry names). For lowestUsage: optional pool (empty = all known accounts). For ordered: preference list. Legacy primaryEmail/secondaryEmail are merged into this list if empty.

claudeAccounts.failover.fableThreshold.description: Fable model-scoped weekly % threshold (meter + optional failover).

claudeAccounts.failover.onSession.description: If true, 5h session pressure at/above sessionThreshold triggers account failover/notify. Tracked always in the meter either way.

claudeAccounts.failover.onWeekly.description: If true, 7d all-models pressure triggers account failover/notify.

claudeAccounts.failover.onFable.description: If true, Fable-only pressure triggers account failover. Default false: leave the account alone so Claude Code can fall back to another model (Sonnet/Opus) when Fable is exhausted.

claudeAccounts.failover.primaryEmail.description: Deprecated: use failover.accountOrder. Still prepended to accountOrder when that list is empty.

claudeAccounts.failover.secondaryEmail.description: Deprecated: use failover.accountOrder. Still appended when accountOrder is empty.

claudeAccounts.workspaceRoutes.description: Hard map of directory trees to Claude account emails. Longest matching pathPrefix wins. Under a match, CLI orch and VS Code auto-select that account when the folder opens (multi-window: work tree in one VS Code, personal in another). No cross-account failover under a match. Example: work monorepos → work email; personal repos → personal email.

email.description: Claude account email that must be used under this tree
